# Giant Spider (`monsters:giant-spider`)
*Large beast, unaligned* | **CR** 1 (XP 200; PB +2)
**AC** 14 | **HP** 26 (4d10 + 4) | **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 2 (-4) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 4 (-3)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +4, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +7
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14
**Languages:** None

## Traits
- **Spider Climb.** The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
- **Web Walker.** The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

## Actions
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- **Web (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
